title: NICE concludes that AI autocontouring is quicker than manual contouring for radiotherapy planning and allows nine systems in the NHS
summary: NICE reviewed 79 studies and concluded that AI autocontouring with clinician review, by systems such as MVision and Limbus Contour, is likely equivalent to manual contouring and quicker.
account: Before radiotherapy, staff outline the tumor and nearby organs on scans, a slow manual task called contouring. The National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) assessed AI software that draws these outlines for a healthcare professional to check and edit. Its external assessment group found 79 studies, 52 of them conference abstracts, and extracted data from 15 priority studies, 8 of them prospective. The evidence showed that AI contours were generally similar to manual ones, with most rated clinically acceptable or needing only minor edits, and that AI contouring was consistently quicker even when review and editing were counted. Reported time savings ranged from 3 to 80 minutes, though some figures left out review time, and clinical experts estimated 10 to 30 minutes. In guidance published on 27 September 2023, the committee concluded that AI autocontouring with review was likely to be clinically equivalent to manual contouring and quicker to do, and it allowed nine systems in the NHS while more evidence is generated. AI outlines of small structures such as the optic nerve and the pituitary gland often needed major edits or were unusable.
purpose: The systems were built to draw organ and target outlines for radiotherapy planning so that staff spend less time contouring. The time saving is that purpose.
system: AI autocontouring software: AI-Rad Companion Organs RT, ART-Plan, DLCExpert, INTContour, Limbus Contour, MIM Contour ProtégéAI, MRCAT Prostate plus Auto-contouring, MVision Segmentation Service and RayStation
developer: Siemens Healthineers, TheraPanacea, Mirada Medical, Carina Medical, Limbus AI, MIM Software, Philips, MVision AI and RaySearch
deployer: Radiotherapy centers in the studies reviewed by NICE; NHS radiotherapy services in England

ratings.reason: Studies reported time savings of 3 to 80 minutes, and experts estimated 10 to 30 minutes, with contours of similar quality.
